factors.explanation: The two teams' tempo deviations add: this game projects 1.8% faster than league average.

factors.label: Opponent Defence
factors.explanation: Opponent defensive rating is 3.3% above league average — a weaker defence, so production projects up.

factors.label: Venue
factors.explanation: Road game; the venue multiplier is 0.988 (-1.2%). Default multiplier, not yet recalibrated from data.

factors.label: Rest
factors.explanation: Three or more days of rest; the rest multiplier is 1.005 (+0.5%). Default multiplier, not yet recalibrated from data.

method.summary: Opportunity x rate, shrunk per statistic.

notes: Projected minutes carry most of the error: supplying true minutes improves points RMSE by 19.3% and rebounds by 17.6%, far more than any model change.
PTS+REB+AST uses the residual correlation: the independent calculation would have claimed an SD of 7.12 against 8.27.

No overdispersion is detectable in the league sample for FG3M, STL, BLK, TOV: the method-of-moments alpha fits at zero, so the predictive distribution is the Poisson limit Var = mean rather than a wider negative binomial. A dispersion multiplier below 1.0 is reported as fitted but cannot narrow an interval past that floor.
